par-led-7x40w-zoom-bee-eye: PAR LED with seven 40 W RGBC 4-in-1 LEDs and a 4° to 60° zoom: narrow the beam to throw light over a distance, or open it up to wash an area. Controlled by DMX512, master-slave, sound or auto mode, with a 1 to 25 Hz strobe, PowerCON and XLR connectors and an LCD screen.
new-1940w-bee-eye-moving-light-power-750: Wash moving head with 19 x 40 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs, a 4° to 60° zoom and a colour temperature adjustable from 2800 to 8500 K. 540° pan, 240° tilt and DMX512 control with several channel modes: a moving head suited to stages and venues that call for dynamic lighting.
par-led-19x15w-zoom-ip65: PAR LED with 19 x 15 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs, rated IP65: its protection against water spray and dust means it can be used outdoors as well as indoors, from -10 °C to 45 °C. The 8° to 60° electronic zoom and DMX512, master-slave, sound or auto control cover most stage setups.
new-mini295w-beam-moving-light-with-ring: Beam moving head with a 295 W lamp and a very tight beam (0 to 3.8°), for aerial effects and beams that cut across the room. It combines colours, gobos and prisms, electronic focus and an LED ring, with 540° pan and 270° tilt controlled by DMX512.
mini230w-beam-moving-light-with-ring: 230 W beam moving head with a 2° beam, 14 colours, 17 gobos, a rainbow wheel and prisms. Its ring of 25 RGB LEDs is pixel-controlled over 18 DMX512 channels and adds a lighting effect around the head, with overheat protection.
ip65-1940w-bee-eye-moving-light-: Wash moving head with 19 x 40 W RGBA 4-in-1 LEDs, rated IP65 against dust and water spray. 10° to 40° electronic zoom, 540° horizontal rotation, LCD touchscreen and several DMX512 channel modes: a moving head for outdoor installations and events.
stage-light-bars-1810w-led-tubo: 97 cm bar with 18 high-power 4-in-1 LEDs, a milky acrylic lens and a 180° angle, to light a backdrop, a façade or a DJ booth with diffused light. Self-cooling fanless aluminium housing, so it runs silently, with 6 built-in programmes and DMX512, auto, master-slave or sound control.
ip65-4812-segments-control-strobe: 400 W LED strobe combining 48 RGB segments and 12 white segments, for white and coloured flashes. Rated IP65, it is suited to outdoor installations, with DMX512, RDM, auto, master-slave or sound control.
battery-3w-animated-laser-light: 3 W RGB laser powered by a 12 V DC input or by its rechargeable 6000 mAh battery. It projects 180 patterns and 60 animations and can be controlled from a smartphone with the LightElf app (iOS and Android).
300w-zoom-cob-spotlight: 300 W COB LED fixture with an 8° to 60° motorised zoom, colour temperature adjustable from 3200 K to 5600 K and a colour rendering index of 95 or higher. Quality white light for specials, backlighting and stage lighting, controlled by DMX512 or standalone.
ip65-4410w-segments-control-flood-light: Fixture with 44 x 15 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs in 11 segments, with fade, jump and strobe effects per section. Rated IP65, with angles of 15°, 25° and 35° or 25°, 45° and 60° depending on the version, and a colour temperature of 2700 to 10000 K.
ip65-1818w-led-big-par-light: PAR LED with 18 x 18 W RGBWA+UV 6-in-1 LEDs in a die-cast aluminium housing, rated IP65 for outdoor use. 25° angle, 0 to 25 Hz strobe and DMX512, sound, auto or master-slave control.
lyre-big-bee-1940w-anneau: Moving head with 19 x 40 W 4-in-1 Osram LEDs and a light ring, usable as wash, beam or spot thanks to its 0 to 60° zoom. It adds whirlwind and kaleidoscope effects and is controlled by DMX512 with several channel modes.
mini-230w-beam-moving-light: 230 W beam moving head with 14 colours plus white, 17 fixed gobos, 8, 16 and 24-facet prisms and electric focus. DMX512 control over 16 channels, with 540° pan and 280° tilt with auto-correction.
1940w-big-bee-moving-light: Wash moving head with 19 individually controllable 40 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs, a 4° to 60° zoom and an output of 37,500 lux at 5 m. Each LED can be controlled separately, by DMX512 or over a network.
lyre-500w-cmy-cto-3en1: 3-in-1 moving head (spot, beam, wash) with a 400 W white LED module, CMY colour mixing, CTO, 8 colours, 16 gobos and 3 and 8-facet prisms. 3° to 45° zoom, DMX512 and RDM control over 25 channels: a versatile fixture for stages that need spot, beam and wash in one head.
1925w-bee-beam-wash-moving-light-k15: Moving head with 19 x 25 W RGBW LEDs, usable as wash, beam and kaleidoscope effect thanks to a 4° to 60° electronic zoom. 16-bit pan and tilt for smooth movement, DMX, Art-Net and RDM control, 3-pin XLR connectors.
8-way-dmx-splitter-booster-with-artnet: DMX splitter-booster with 8 inputs/outputs in a 19-inch 1U rack format, with a TCP/IP Art-Net network interface. It distributes and regenerates the DMX512 signal across several lines, with firmware updates via USB or the network.
6-way-dmx-truss-splitter: Small DMX splitter with one 3-pin XLR input and six 3-pin XLR outputs, plus a Thru output. Its compact size (130 × 115 × 115 mm, under one kilo) lets you mount it on a truss to split a DMX line close to the fixtures.
200w-488-segment-strobe: 200 W RGBW LED strobe made up of 48 + 12 segments, for flashes and chase effects at parties and shows. The full data sheet is available on request on +33 6 31 94 96 53.
1818w-rgbwauv-pixel-control-bar-light: Pixel-control LED bar with 18 x 18 W RGBWA+UV 6-in-1 LEDs, to create colour effects that travel along the bar. The full data sheet is available on request on +33 6 31 94 96 53.
ip65-6010w-flood-light: Fixture with 60 x 10 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs, rated IP65, with 25° and 35° angles, a colour LCD screen and three fans. For façade, stage or outdoor lighting, in DMX512, auto or master-slave mode.
ip65-4410w-flood-light: PAR LED with 44 x 12 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs (528 W), rated IP65, with 25° and 35° angles and 16.7 million colours. DMX512, RDM, auto or master-slave control to light a stage, a façade or outdoor décor.
ip65-1818w-led-par-light-ultra: PAR LED with 18 x 10 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs (120 W), 45° angle, four-digit display and IP65 protection. A wide beam to wash an area, controlled by DMX512, sound, auto or master-slave.
ip65-1818w-led-par-light: PAR LED with 18 x 18 W RGBWA+UV LEDs offering three beam angles (25°, 35° and 45°) to suit the distance and the area to be lit. Rated IP65, with a 1 to 20 Hz strobe, 0 to 100% dimmer and DMX512, sound or auto control.
ip65-1218w-battery-par-light: Battery-powered PAR LED with 12 x 18 W RGBWA+UV 6-in-1 LEDs, rated IP65, with a 15° angle. The 8800 mAh battery and wireless control (iOS and Android WiFi app, 2.4 GHz DMX) let you set it up without cables, indoors or outdoors.
ip65-618w-mini-battery-par-light: Mini-size battery-powered PAR LED with six 18 W LEDs and an IP65 rating for outdoor use. With no power cable, it is easy to place to dress a set or installation. The full data sheet is available on request on +33 6 31 94 96 53.
ip65-618w-battery-par-light: Battery-powered PAR LED with six 18 W LEDs, rated IP65 for outdoor use. With no power cable, you can move it and place it wherever the event or installation needs it. The full data sheet is available on request on +33 6 31 94 96 53.
1818w-rgbwauv-led-par-light: PAR LED with 18 x 18 W RGBWA+UV LEDs, including ultraviolet light that makes fluorescent fabrics and décor glow. The full data sheet is available on request on +33 6 31 94 96 53.
418w-battery-parlight: Mini battery-powered PAR LED with four 18 W RGBWA+UV LEDs, 12.8 cm square and 1 kg. 5200 mAh battery, remote control, WiFi app (iOS and Android) and 2.4 GHz DMX for cable-free setup on a table, a set or a stage.
barre-led-sunstrip-10x50w: Wall bar with 10 x 50 W halogen lamps whose warm 2900 K light recalls classic stage lights. DMX512 and RDM control over 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10 channels, with 0 to 100% dimming, 1 to 25 Hz strobe, and mounting and floor brackets supplied with the bar.
barre-led-sunstrip-10x50w-x2: Two Sunstrip wall bars with 10 x 50 W halogen lamps at a set price, to dress a stage wall or a dance floor with warm 2900 K light. Each bar is controlled by DMX512 and RDM, with dimming, 1 to 25 Hz strobe, and mounting and floor brackets.
barre-led-sunstrip-10x50w-x4: Four Sunstrip wall bars with 10 x 50 W halogen lamps at a set price, to equip a stage backdrop or a whole room. Each bar is controlled by DMX512 and RDM, with dimming, 1 to 25 Hz strobe, and mounting and floor brackets.
lyre-wash-220w-19x8w-x2: Set of two wash moving heads with 19 x 8 W RGBW 4-in-1 LEDs (220 W each), motorised zoom and an LED light strip. Motorised pan and tilt, DMX512, sound, auto or master-slave control: everything to equip a stage, bar, nightclub or karaoke night with two identical heads.
machine-etincelles-800w: 800 W electronic spark machine, freestanding and compact, producing cold sparks to highlight an entrance, a finale or a key moment. Four heights selectable by remote control (2 m, 2.5 m, 3 m or 3.5 m) suit the effect to the room. Remote control included.
machine-etincelles-800w-x2: Set of two 800 W electronic spark machines, freestanding and compact. Each offers four spark heights selectable by remote control (2 m, 2.5 m, 3 m or 3.5 m), to frame a stage or dance floor. Remote controls included.
machine-etincelles-800w-x4: Set of four 800 W electronic spark machines, freestanding and compact. Each offers four spark heights selectable by remote control (2 m, 2.5 m, 3 m or 3.5 m), for a large-scale effect on a stage or in a venue. Remote controls included.
jet-de-scene-2m-30s-argent: Single-use silver stage jet with a 2-metre range and a 30-second burn, for a stage entrance or a show finale.
jet-de-scene-2m-30s-or: Single-use gold stage jet with a 2-metre range and a 30-second burn, for a stage entrance or a show finale.
jet-de-scene-3m-30s-argent: Single-use silver stage jet with a 3-metre range and a 30-second burn, for a bigger effect on a large stage or in a high-ceilinged venue.
jet-de-scene-3m-30s-or: Single-use gold stage jet with a 3-metre range and a 30-second burn, for a bigger effect on a large stage or in a high-ceilinged venue.
canon-confettis-electrique-80cm: 80 cm rechargeable electric confetti cannon with instant firing and no powder or gas. Suited to venues and events that prefer to avoid pyrotechnics.
poudre-machine-etincelles-indoor: Cold spark machine powder, indoor version, in a 200 g bag. Compatible with the shop's 800 W spark machines.
poudre-machine-etincelles-outdoor: Cold spark machine powder, outdoor version, in a 200 g bag. Compatible with the shop's 800 W spark machines.
